import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'DejaVu Sans'

# --- Data ---
research = [
    ("2012-09", "AlexNet", "high"),
    ("2014-06", "GANs", "high"),
    ("2014-09", "Seq2Seq +\nAttention", "medium"),
    ("2015-12", "ResNet", "medium"),
    ("2016-03", "AlphaGo vs\nLee Sedol", "critical"),
    ("2017-06", "Transformer\narchitecture", "critical"),
    ("2018-06", "GPT-1", "medium"),
    ("2018-10", "BERT", "high"),
    ("2020-05", "GPT-3", "critical"),
    ("2021-01", "DALL-E\n& CLIP", "high"),
    ("2022-04", "PaLM", "medium"),
    ("2023-03", "GPT-4", "critical"),
    ("2024-02", "Gemini 1.5\n(1M ctx)", "high"),
    ("2024-09", "o1 reasoning", "high"),
    ("2025-02", "Claude 3.5\n/ GPT-4.5", "high"),
]
industry = [
    ("2011-10", "Siri", "high"),
    ("2014-11", "Amazon\nEcho/Alexa", "high"),
    ("2016-09", "Google Translate\ngoes neural", "medium"),
    ("2018-05", "Google\nDuplex", "medium"),
    ("2020-06", "GPT-3 API", "high"),
    ("2021-06", "GitHub\nCopilot", "high"),
    ("2022-08", "Stable\nDiffusion", "high"),
    ("2022-11", "ChatGPT", "critical"),
    ("2023-02", "Bing +\nGPT-4", "high"),
    ("2023-07", "Llama 2\n(open)", "high"),
    ("2024-01", "AI agents in\nenterprise", "high"),
    ("2024-05", "GPT-4o", "medium"),
    ("2025-01", "AI coding\nagents", "high"),
]
regulation = [
    ("2016-10", "Obama AI\nreport", "medium"),
    ("2018-04", "EU GDPR", "high"),
    ("2019-04", "EU AI Ethics\nGuidelines", "medium"),
    ("2020-02", "EU AI\nWhite Paper", "medium"),
    ("2021-04", "EU AI Act\nproposed", "high"),
    ("2022-10", "US AI Bill\nof Rights", "medium"),
    ("2023-05", "EU AI Act\nagreed", "critical"),
    ("2023-07", "WH voluntary\ncommitments", "high"),
    ("2023-10", "Biden\nExec Order", "critical"),
    ("2023-11", "Bletchley\nDeclaration", "high"),
    ("2024-03", "EU AI Act\nenacted", "critical"),
    ("2024-11", "California\nSB 1047", "high"),
    ("2025-02", "EU AI Act\nenforcement", "high"),
]

investment_data = [
    (2010, 1.3), (2011, 1.9), (2012, 2.5), (2013, 3.2), (2014, 5.5),
    (2015, 8.5), (2016, 12.2), (2017, 18.5), (2018, 28.4), (2019, 32.1),
    (2020, 36.5), (2021, 52.8), (2022, 48.2), (2023, 67.2), (2024, 95.8),
    (2025, 120.5),
]

def parse_date(s):
    parts = s.split('-')
    return datetime(int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), 1)

# --- Colors (editorial palette) ---
colors = {
    'Research': '#1B6B93',
    'Industry': '#E8890C',
    'Regulation': '#A04747',
}
track_bg = {
    'Research': '#E8F4F8',
    'Industry': '#FFF3E0',
    'Regulation': '#FAEAEA',
}
significance_size = {'critical': 11, 'high': 7.5, 'medium': 5}
sig_edge = {'critical': 2.0, 'high': 1.2, 'medium': 0.8}
sig_zorder = {'critical': 10, 'high': 8, 'medium': 6}

# --- Layout ---
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(26, 14), facecolor='#FAFAFA')

# Create gridspec: 3 track rows + investment bar
gs = fig.add_gridspec(4, 1, height_ratios=[1, 1, 1, 0.45], hspace=0.08,
                       left=0.04, right=0.96, top=0.89, bottom=0.06)

ax_research = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax_industry = fig.add_subplot(gs[1], sharex=ax_research)
ax_regulation = fig.add_subplot(gs[2], sharex=ax_research)
ax_invest = fig.add_subplot(gs[3], sharex=ax_research)

axes_tracks = [ax_research, ax_industry, ax_regulation]
tracks_data = [
    ('Research', research),
    ('Industry', industry),
    ('Regulation', regulation),
]

xmin = datetime(2010, 1, 1)
xmax = datetime(2025, 12, 1)

# ChatGPT date for the highlight
chatgpt_date = datetime(2022, 11, 1)

for idx, (ax, (track_name, events)) in enumerate(zip(axes_tracks, tracks_data)):
    ax.set_facecolor(track_bg[track_name])
    color = colors[track_name]

    # Draw ChatGPT highlight zone
    ax.axvspan(chatgpt_date, xmax, alpha=0.08, color='#FF6B6B', zorder=0)

    # Horizontal line for timeline
    ax.axhline(y=0.5, color=color, alpha=0.3, linewidth=1.5, zorder=1)

    dates = [parse_date(e[0]) for e in events]

    # Alternate labels above and below
    for i, (date_str, label, sig) in enumerate(events):
        dt = parse_date(date_str)
        ms = significance_size[sig]
        ew = sig_edge[sig]
        zo = sig_zorder[sig]

        ax.plot(dt, 0.5, 'o', color=color, markersize=ms,
                markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=ew, zorder=zo)

        # Stagger labels
        if i % 2 == 0:
            y_text = 0.82
            va = 'bottom'
            y_line = 0.58
        else:
            y_text = 0.18
            va = 'top'
            y_line = 0.42

        fontsize = 7.2 if sig == 'critical' else 6.5 if sig == 'high' else 6.0
        fontweight = 'bold' if sig == 'critical' else 'medium'

        ax.annotate(label, xy=(dt, 0.5), xytext=(dt, y_text),
                    fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight,
                    ha='center', va=va, color='#2C2C2C',
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=color, alpha=0.4, lw=0.7),
                    zorder=12)

    # Track label on left
    ax.text(xmin, 0.5, f'  {track_name.upper()}', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
            color=color, va='center', ha='left', zorder=15,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor=color, alpha=0.9))

    ax.set_xlim(xmin, xmax)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.set_yticks([])

    if idx < 2:
        ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelbottom=False, length=0)
        ax.spines['bottom'].set_visible(False)
    else:
        ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelbottom=False, length=0)
        ax.spines['bottom'].set_visible(False)

    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# --- Investment overlay (bar chart) ---
ax_invest.set_facecolor('#F5F5F5')
inv_years = [datetime(y, 7, 1) for y, _ in investment_data]
inv_vals = [v for _, v in investment_data]

bar_colors = ['#FF6B6B' if y >= 2023 else '#90A4AE' for y, _ in investment_data]
bars = ax_invest.bar(inv_years, inv_vals, width=200, color=bar_colors, alpha=0.85,
                     edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=5)

# Labels on key bars
for i, (y, v) in enumerate(investment_data):
    if y in [2010, 2017, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]:
        ax_invest.text(datetime(y, 7, 1), v + 2.5, f'${v:.0f}B',
                      ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold',
                      color='#2C2C2C')

ax_invest.set_ylabel('AI Investment\n($ Billion)', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                     color='#555555', labelpad=8)
ax_invest.set_ylim(0, 140)
ax_invest.set_yticks([0, 50, 100])
ax_invest.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=7, colors='#888888')
ax_invest.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_invest.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_invest.spines['left'].set_alpha(0.3)
ax_invest.spines['bottom'].set_alpha(0.3)

# X-axis on investment panel
ax_invest.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.YearLocator())
ax_invest.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y'))
ax_invest.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8, colors='#555555')

# ChatGPT highlight
ax_invest.axvspan(chatgpt_date, xmax, alpha=0.06, color='#FF6B6B', zorder=0)

# --- ChatGPT vertical marker across all panels ---
for ax in [ax_research, ax_industry, ax_regulation, ax_invest]:
    ax.axvline(x=chatgpt_date, color='#E53935', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=3)

# ChatGPT annotation
ax_research.annotate('ChatGPT Launch\nNov 2022', xy=(chatgpt_date, 0.98),
                     xytext=(datetime(2021, 3, 1), 0.98),
                     fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#E53935',
                     ha='center', va='top',
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#E53935', lw=1.5),
                     zorder=20)

# --- Title ---
fig.suptitle('The AI Timeline: Research, Industry & Regulation (2010–2025)',
             fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color='#1A1A1A', y=0.97,
             fontfamily='DejaVu Sans')

fig.text(0.5, 0.935,
         'Research breakthroughs lead industry adoption by 2–4 years; regulation lags further behind  —  '
         'until ChatGPT compressed the cycle to months',
         ha='center', fontsize=11, color='#555555', style='italic')

# --- Legend ---
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=colors['Research'],
           markersize=10, label='Research', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=colors['Industry'],
           markersize=10, label='Industry', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=colors['Regulation'],
           markersize=10, label='Regulation', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#333333',
           markersize=11, label='Critical', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=2),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#333333',
           markersize=7.5, label='High', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#333333',
           markersize=5, label='Medium', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.15, label='Post-ChatGPT acceleration'),
]

fig.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right',
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.96, 0.91), ncol=7, fontsize=8,
           frameon=True, facecolor='white', edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
           handletextpad=0.3, columnspacing=1.0)

# --- Callout: lag stats ---
fig.text(0.04, 0.015,
         'Key insight: Transformer (2017) → ChatGPT (2022) = 5.4 yr gap  |  '
         'ChatGPT (Nov 2022) → Biden EO + EU AI Act + Bletchley Declaration = all within 14 months  |  '
         'AI investment doubled from $48B (2022) to $96B (2024)',
         fontsize=7.5, color='#777777', style='italic')

fig.text(0.96, 0.015, 'Source: compiled milestone data & global AI investment figures',
         fontsize=6.5, color='#AAAAAA', ha='right')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='#FAFAFA', edgecolor='none')
print("Chart saved successfully.")
